memory_candidates.insight: In this tree, a BACKWARD liveness condition must hand `live` the REVERSED relation, because `Present.lean`'s `live`/`HasChain` always ask for an infinite FORWARD chain `G (f n) (f (n+1))`. The house precedent is `bwdLive`, which passes `pathTypes … y x` to `live`. Writing the forward spelling instead yields an equivalent condition over a finite carrier, but reachable only via cycle extraction, so a backward persistence stretch cannot be read off it directly.

Trialling a whole new Lean section in a scratch file via `lake env lean`, importing the already-built target module, verified ~200 lines of proof in one elaboration and let the real module be edited exactly once. Cheaper than editing-then-iterating when the section is self-contained and the dependency module is already built.
